questionText: Evaluate the suitability of this kitchen/living space for a family with children.
stem: A popular open plan kitchen/living space is shown below. (www.roomsketcher.com)

options: Large space to meet family needs
same flooring throughout, no transition strip that could be trip hazard
kitchen table can be used for completion of homework when other family members prepare dinner
can watch children playing in living room while preparing food
good amount of natural light entering room
useful to have more worktop space on far side of hob
not enough chairs at kitchen table for all family members to eat together

heldReason: Marks a floor plan printed on the paper. Every option describes that image ("same flooring throughout, no transition strip", "not enough chairs at kitchen table", "useful to have more worktop space on far side of hob"), so the card is unanswerable without the figure and the markdown extraction does not carry it.

questionText: Comment on the suitability of the athleisure wear outfits shown above. Refer to: comfort; function; design features.
stem: ‘Athleisure wear is the fashion trend that can be worn anywhere anytime.’ (www.squatwolf.com)

options: stretch fabric allows for ease of movement
zipped jacket, more comfortable when unzipped, can be removed easily
flat shoes, comfortable with soft sole
suited to warm and cold weather
central opening of jackets with zip detail

heldReason: Marks two outfit photographs printed on the paper. The comfort and design-features strands describe those images directly ("round neck t-shirts not restrictive", "zipped jacket", "pull-string waist band", "central opening of jackets with zip detail"), so the card is unanswerable without the figures and the markdown extraction does not carry them.
